document.pages: Printed p.15, 3P selection block and diagram E45095; ratings printed p.14

modelingNotes: Manufacturer-authored Italian catalog, Catalogo 2010-2011, mirrored by Yumpu (job provenance identifies distributor carnevale.bz). Printed p.15, 3P table, 63 A row, curva C column explicitly specifies 24290; no successor or accessory substitution.

Printed p.15 diagram E45095 applies to the 3P selection block: terminal pairs 1-2, 3-4, 5-6; dashed mechanical ganging does not connect poles electrically. Open contact state follows the drawn reference position, not an assertion of installed operating state. No permanent links.
Printed p.14: rated current 63 A at 30 degrees C; C-curve magnetic operation between 5 and 10 times In. Current metadata represents rated current, not conductor ampacity or a simulated trip curve.

Printed p.14: Ue 400 V AC; CEI EN 60898 Icn 6000 A at 400 V for 3P (O-CO). CEI EN 60947-2 Icu 20 kA at 230-240 V and 10 kA at 400-415 V for 3P (O-CO); Ui 500 V AC and Uimp 6 kV. These are conditional capabilities; no nominal_voltage or exclusive AC-only restriction is assigned in the model.
For In 32-63 A, p.14 cage terminals accept up to 25 mm2 flexible or 35 mm2 rigid conductors. Connection policy does not assert multiple conductors fit one clamp.

Scope is the base 24290 breaker: six main electrical connections, no neutral, PE, shield, communication or auxiliary terminals in the applicable diagram. Separately added auxiliary or residual-current equipment requires its own model. Terminal numbers are literal manufacturer labels; endpoint descriptions do not assign phases or a mandatory feed direction.

No terminal is universally required by this inventory model: pole use is application-dependent. Contact functions and ganged_with relations provide circuit representation only; protection dynamics and installation suitability are not simulated.

connectionCoverage.notes: Complete six-terminal inventory for the base 24290 breaker per its 3P catalog diagram: 1/2, 3/4, 5/6. No separately ordered accessory connections included; no PE or neutral terminal shown for this three-pole device.
